verdict: A zero-spend day drove a sharp lead drop; pipeline intake needs attention.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 97 leads at an average cost of $7.60 per lead, but the most recent 7-day window took a hit: a confirmed zero-spend day on September 12 produced zero leads and pushed your weekly cost per lead up 85% versus the prior week. Google Business Profile actions also fell sharply week-over-week, pointing to softer demand or reduced visibility beyond paid ads alone. Ad spend has been restored and is running normally. Separately, 99 opportunities have entered your pipeline this period with no appointments or closed wins recorded — leads are arriving but stalling at intake, which is a front-desk process question, not an ads issue, and one worth reviewing on your end.
